Source family: 得. Modal děi contrasted with complement de. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 人家. Informal 人家, referent and ambiguity. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 却. 却 and expectation-disconfirming predicates. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 未必. 未必 as possibility, contrasted with definite negation. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 几乎、似乎. 似乎 is explained; 几乎 has no owned card here. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 的确、反而、还4、竟然、究竟. 的确、反而、究竟、竟然 are instructed; the entire printed family is not complete. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 对于. 对于 introduces the target of a view, with register comparison. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 替. 替 introduces acting for another person. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 根据. 根据 as an evidential basis, contrasted with 按照 following instructions. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 此外、而1、而是、既然、可见、甚至、假如、总之. Several listed conjunctions are instructed; other forms remain. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.

Source family: “把”字句2：表处置（1） 主语+把+宾语+动词（+一/了）+动词（2）主语+把+宾语（+给）+动词+了/着（3）主语+把+宾语+动词+动量补语/时量补语. Disposal with a result/location is taught; not all three printed structures. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 不是……，而是……. 不是…而是 distinguishes the rejected and asserted claims. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: ……，于是……. 于是 introduces the resulting next action; 因此 comparison. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: ……，否则……. 否则 warns what happens without the stated action. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 万一……，（就）……. 万一 introduces a contingency, not an established fact. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 不管……，都/也……. 不管…都 invariance across named conditions. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 无论……，都/也……. 无论…都 contrasted with conditional rather than universal claims. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 既然……，就……. 既然 known reason and 就 proposed consequence. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 哪怕……，也/还……. 哪怕…也 extreme condition while preserving the result. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 用双重否定表示强调. Double negation does not remove the following qualification. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 用“连……也/都……”表示强调. 连…都 emphasizes an unexpected member of a set. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 毕竟、不免、差（一）点儿、倒是、干脆、就4、居然、可2、明明、总算. 毕竟、明明、倒是、居然、可 explained; printed family has further forms. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 随着. 随着 connects a change and its accompanying development. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 在……看来. 在…看来 marks a viewpoint, not an uncontested fact. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.

Source family: 状态补语2：动词/形容词+得+短语 （1）动词/形容词+得+动词短语（2）动词/形容词+得+主谓短语（3）动词/形容词+得+固定短语. 得 plus an explanatory clause taught; not all printed phrase classes. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 尽管……，但是/可是……. 尽管 accepted fact contrasted with hypothetical 即使. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 再……也……. 再…也 concession at an extreme degree. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: X归X，Y归Y. X归X concession taught; paired Y归Y structure not exhaustively contrasted. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 从而、加上、完了、一旦. 一旦、从而 taught; 加上 and 完了 remain unowned. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 拿……来说. 拿…来说 draws a situated example into discussion. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: A的A，B的B. A的A，B的B distributes different actions across people. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.

Source family: 趋向补语4 表示时间意义（引申用法） （1）表示动作行为的开始：动词+上/起来（2）表示动作行为的持续：动词+下去/下来. Onset 讨论起来 and continuation 下去; all printed complement senses are not exhausted. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 或是……，或是……. 或是 coordinates alternatives, with clause structure. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 一旦……，就……. 一旦…就 trigger and response. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 除非……，才……. 除非…才 frames the required exceptional condition. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 除非……，否则/不然……. 除非…否则 distinguishes the exception and default consequence. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: ……，为的是……. 为的是 states purpose, not a guaranteed result. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: ……，以便……. 以便 written purpose/result-enabling register. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 用“怎么都/也+不/没”表示强调. 怎么…也/都不 strong rejection across alternatives. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 凭. 凭 makes the evidential basis explicit; one item need not establish a broad claim. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 依据. 依据 introduces evidence, contrasted with unsupported assertion. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 比较句5：（1）跟……相比 （2）A+形容词+B+数量补语. 跟…相比 taught; quantitative comparative pattern still unowned. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 即使……，也……. 即使…也 hypothetical concession. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 没有……就没有……. 没有…就没有 necessary dependence, not a promise of success. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 用副词“可”表示强调. Emphatic 可 and its conversational tone. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 真有你/他/她的. 真有你的 can praise or tease; relationship/context matters. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: X什么X. X什么X rejects the proposed action; potentially blunt register. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 番、声、趟. 番 instruction only; 声 and 趟 are not owned by these cards. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 至于. 至于 changes the topic or restricts a different issue. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 据. 据 states an information source; 截至 time boundary kept separate. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
Source family: 不料、可3、若. 若 is taught; 不料 and colloquial 可 not covered as this family. Explicit AI-assisted cards inspected; native review pending. Introduction is not mastery.
